# Architecture (logical / component view)

**Use when:** you need the software components of a system and how they call each other, independent of where they run.

## Purpose
A logical view: clients, services, APIs, messaging and data stores, with the calls and
data flows between them. It is the everyday whiteboard diagram, made rigorous. For a
strict, notation-backed version use `c4-container`; for vendor icons use `cloud`.

## Spec settings
- `"type": "architecture"`, `"layout": "flowchart-lr"`: users/clients on the left,
  edge/gateway, services in the middle, data on the right.
- Theme: `professional` (auto); `blueprint` or `dark` for presentations.

## Node kinds
| Kind | Use for |
|---|---|
| `user` | Human actors (`Customer`, `Support Agent`). |
| `client`, `webapp`, `mobile` | Front ends: browser SPA, web app, mobile app. |
| `gateway`, `loadbalancer` | API gateway, ingress, load balancer. |
| `api`, `service`, `worker`, `function` | Back-end components; one node per deployable/owned unit. |
| `queue`, `topic` | Message queue, pub/sub topic, event bus. |
| `database`, `cache`, `storage`, `search`, `vector-db` | Data stores; one node per logical store. |
| `external` | Third-party systems (Stripe, SAP, an email provider). |

Avoid flowchart kinds (`process`, `decision`) and provider icons here; if the audience
needs to see Azure/AWS/GCP services, switch to a `cloud` diagram.

## Groups
- `tier` groups for layers: `Presentation`, `Application`, `Data` (left to right).
- `boundary` for trust boundaries (DMZ, internal network, PCI zone); `external` for
  third parties; `system` when several systems share the page.
- Do not frame single nodes; do not nest more than 2-3 levels in a logical view.

## Edges
- Label every meaningful edge with protocol or verb: `HTTPS`, `gRPC`, `SQL`,
  `publishes OrderPlaced`, `reads` (`[edge-labels]`).
- `solid` = synchronous request; `dashed` = async message/event; `dotted` = optional.
- Arrow from caller to callee (request direction). For pub/sub: producer -> topic ->
  consumer.
- Avoid two-way arrows; the reply is implied by a synchronous call.

## Checklist
- [ ] Left-to-right: actors -> front end -> services -> data
- [ ] Each node is a real, named component, <= 4 words, tech in `technology`
- [ ] Edges labeled with protocols/verbs; async dashed
- [ ] Externals outside internal tiers
- [ ] One highlight at most (the new or changed component)

## Common mistakes
- Arrows without labels ("box and line salad").
- Shared database drawn as several boxes, or several databases drawn as one.
- Mixing logical components with infrastructure (VMs, subnets) - that is `deployment`.
- Putting the technology in the label (`Orders API (Node.js on AKS)`).

## Example
```json
{
  "title": "Orders Platform - Logical View",
  "subtitle": "Checkout path - v2.1, Oct 2026",
  "type": "architecture",
  "layout": "flowchart-lr",
  "groups": [
    {"id": "presentation", "label": "Presentation", "kind": "tier"},
    {"id": "application", "label": "Application", "kind": "tier"},
    {"id": "data", "label": "Data", "kind": "tier"},
    {"id": "third_party", "label": "Third Parties", "kind": "external"}
  ],
  "nodes": [
    {"id": "customer", "label": "Customer", "kind": "user"},
    {"id": "web", "label": "Storefront", "kind": "webapp", "group": "presentation", "technology": "React"},
    {"id": "gateway", "label": "API Gateway", "kind": "gateway", "group": "application"},
    {"id": "orders", "label": "Orders API", "kind": "api", "group": "application", "technology": "Python / FastAPI"},
    {"id": "billing", "label": "Billing Service", "kind": "service", "group": "application", "technology": "Go"},
    {"id": "events", "label": "Order Events", "kind": "queue", "group": "application", "technology": "Kafka"},
    {"id": "orders_db", "label": "Orders DB", "kind": "database", "group": "data", "technology": "PostgreSQL"},
    {"id": "cache", "label": "Session Cache", "kind": "cache", "group": "data", "technology": "Redis"},
    {"id": "stripe", "label": "Stripe", "kind": "external", "group": "third_party"}
  ],
  "edges": [
    {"source": "customer", "target": "web", "label": "HTTPS"},
    {"source": "web", "target": "gateway", "label": "REST"},
    {"source": "gateway", "target": "orders", "label": "REST"},
    {"source": "gateway", "target": "cache", "label": "reads session"},
    {"source": "orders", "target": "orders_db", "label": "SQL"},
    {"source": "orders", "target": "events", "label": "publishes", "style": "dashed"},
    {"source": "events", "target": "billing", "label": "OrderPlaced", "style": "dashed"},
    {"source": "billing", "target": "stripe", "label": "charges"}
  ]
}
```
